facts.fact: Taesia 开卷：地基被 Orsus 扭曲到「看一眼都头疼」；Julian 的 shell-shocked——「她对神设的警告全白费」；「她希望此刻能抛下野心、只是和他们在一起——以他们想要的、应得的方式柔软。Her brother. Her Hunter. She wanted to go home with them.」「Then you know what to do, Nyx said.」；北门无人来犯——「Phos 留下的唯一联系。Not the last, Nyx corrected.」（Nikolas 之翼闪回）；神庙=「a bulwark of faith and fury——Phos 的钠焰怒气自廊柱漫出」——已察觉 Nyx 与 Orsus（Nyx 苦乐参半）
facts.anchor: a bulwark of faith and fury

facts.fact: amalgam 拦路：Lorz 的脸嵌着（incredulous 如 Faün 被吞前）；Risha 短发染金血、双镰湿——「The determination in her was just the same. The penetrating, disapproving stare.」；「Of course you would try to stop me.」「Only from targeting the wrong person——Angelica burned off Ulshära's feather.」「Rian didn't have a feather either.」「There is a chance. But we decided not to kill her unless it actually happened. We can't leave Solara leaderless. We need an ally.」——Taesia 找审判、只有平静务实「List out my crimes. Condemn me.」「I'm not here to condemn you, Taesia. I'm here to help you.」——Nyx「别理她——她在让你偏离目的」——「How about you shut the fuck up for one second?（她发誓听到神嘟囔）」
facts.anchor: I’m not here to condemn you, Taesia.

facts.fact: fulcrum 双组份通报：「The god's fulcrum is here. In Phos's throne. Which means we need to get Phos out of it.」「I thought it was in the Sunbringer Spear?」「It's likely both. The fulcrums…They're split between a physical component and a spiritual one. The physical component is in the throne. The spiritual one…I'm not sure. It might be in the Sunbringer Spear. It might not.」——Taesia 望 Starfell「她早知它是 Nyx fulcrum 的一部分——如今她想知道是哪一部分。That's why he can't possess the sword——她省悟（脉搏加速）」；「Forget about Ulshära. Let me watch over her while you deal with Phos.」
facts.anchor: It might be in the Sunbringer Spear. It might not.

facts.fact: 「Because I get it now」：「Why do you want to help me?」「Because I get it now. Your anger, your frustration. Everything you did to try to change a corrupt system.」——她的目光灼着真实之怒（比 Phos 的更让 Taesia 震动）「We can't fix such a damaged world with gentleness. You knew that from the start.」（粉红泪痕）；「八英尺与二十年的距离」——蒙太奇（复活老鼠逗乐/图书馆情色区憋笑/派对影中偷棕榈酒）——「They were a god's general and a vengeful wraith.」「What happened to you?」
facts.anchor: a god’s general and a vengeful wraith.

facts.fact: 西门与挑衅：琴火墙 dismissed——Rorik 破城；「若琴不够、口哨也不够——Deia's eye 是仅剩的牌，但用得起吗？」；Cosima「You're not doing anything without me.」「You want to be in the blast radius?」「Maybe I do. Maybe I'm into that.」「You know your fire doesn't hurt me anymore. I'm not lettin' you do this alone.」；她假装凑近挣脱、封死楼梯「I said at the beginning that this is beyond you. Shedding blood isn't enough.」——乘风越阵落地；Rorik「You can fly without wings. Most interesting.」「There are four other elements you haven't seen.」；土墙围军团——「Are you so eager to show off?……Lord Phos calls.」——「His words were cactus needles under her nails. King Ferdinand、mage Eran Liolle——他们都低估过她。And now they were dead.」；「Ulma!」（白翼女将、喉底羽灰纹如宝石、falchion）vs Cosima（dexterity vs strength；lightspeed 绕后）；「Enough!」——Rorik「不过是个兴奋看决斗的男孩；他的兵是看自家猫玩猎物的猫」；Ulma feint 剖开 Cosima 肋腹
facts.anchor: His words were cactus needles under her nails.

facts.fact: 「但开眼的是她」：Ulshära 金闪赶到 disarmed Ulma 推下城齿「Don't do this, Rorik!」——「话语变得无意义。灰色。无味。她无法移开视线——Cosima 皮肤上的裂口、血渗衣落向圣地石板」；「Her breath blistered her throat. Her terror was divine. She dove into that fear, tearing into its pulp with her fingernails……grasped it like she had once grasped the blood-hot organ of a worthless man. It was not Deia's command that opened the third eye, but hers.」；「魔法多肢而无处不在——睫毛、毛孔、她的名字里都有种子」「Why had she denied herself what she'd most wanted? She was a column of starfire and molten wrath……She was beautiful. She was beyond control and all the more powerful for it. Except this time she wasn't objectiveless, and there was no Deia to distract her.」
facts.anchor: It was not Deia’s command that opened the third eye, but hers.

facts.fact: 减为灰：风卷走 Cosima/Ulshära、石墙一念崩——「Rorik 一步未完——Angelica unleashed her will outward and reduced him to ash.」；「The forge was inside her……这些兵永远看不到 Nexus、永远无法向她的姐妹、她的母亲、Asami 和 Akane 抬手」「If freeing her magic always meant losing control, then she could decide when to release it. If her protection always meant destruction, then at least she could aim that devastation at those who most deserved it.」——「神力炸穿 Divine City、建筑碳化；Flesh——none of it was left, only fragments of bone.」；耳语劝她继续（「拆了 Phos 的凡体」）——黑烟自口涌出、皮肤 papery——「Just like her unbridled descent at the base of Mount Netsai.『Angelica!』——与那次一样，有人喊她回来。不像低语，这声音在她胸腔里唱。Close.」——无需疼痛之助、第三眼缓缓阖上 sated；「西部全毁：熔化的武器与羽灰的坟场、一颗牙落在靴边」「It felt like it wasn't enough. It felt like she should have mourned. It felt even better than her violin.」；「臂上的掌印终于不疼了。Maybe Deia's whispers had some merit of truth to them. Maybe Angelica could become a mortal god.」
